resolution.note: preflight passes test/rules to the suite, which selects it through TEST_FILE_GLOB; test/rules/preflight-parity.test.ts compares the preflight and CI sets under test/rules. Preflight stays the cheap pre-review subset; the full suite stays in CI (D30).

title: Run every CI test file in preflight
body:
Outcome: npm run preflight runs every test file CI runs, including test/rules/*.mjs; an observer that compares the preflight and CI test sets is red at base. Three PASS reviews were voided by CI-only rule tests (#138, #148, #159).
Evidence: .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (operator grant ./grant.md, 2026-11-01).
